entities.summary: Zlynka is a town and the administrative center of Zlynkovsky District in Bryansk Oblast, Russia, located on the Zlynka River 225 kilometers (140 mi) southwest of Bryansk, the administrative center of the oblast, and close to the border with Belarus. Population: 5,270 (2021 census); 5,507 (2010 census); 5,372 (2002 census); 5,586 (1989 Soviet census).
